title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: VENERABLE FAMILY RESIDENCE
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: VENERABLE FAMILY RESIDENCE

  CHC-2026-3234-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-3235-CE  Council District: 8 – Harris-Dawson
  Plan Area: South Los Angeles  Last Day to Act: 07-24-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  2921 South Budlong Avenue

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  Review of the Historic-Cultural Monument application, pursuant to Los Angeles Administrative Code
  Section 22.171.10, to determine whether to take the proposed designation of a Monument under
  consideration.

  Owners:  Santiago M. Pamplona and Corinne A. Bower; Audrey Lopez

  Applicants:  Raymond Hurley and Laura Meyers, West Adams Heritage Association
summary: Review of the Historic-Cultural Monument application for the Venerable Family Residence at 2921 South Budlong Avenue in South Los Angeles to determine whether to take the proposed designation under consideration.
